title: Original tunes, record-based style and the 1957 New Orleans revival
summary: Australian bandleaders wrote original tunes, the music was learned from records, and interest in Bunk Johnson and George Lewis style only came with the Melbourne New Orleans Band in 1957.

story.theme_name: Pianists: who played, who influenced whom
story.community_name: What the word "jazz" means: origins, Dixieland and labels
